class.name: OcgGCMakecircle2d
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for circles in the plane. The result is a `Geom2d_Circle`. A `GC_MakeCircle2d` object provides a framework for: - defining the construction parameters; - running the construction algorithm; - querying the construction status and the resulting circle via `Value()`.
class.description: ! This class implements construction algorithms for circles in the plane. ! The result is a `Geom2d_Circle`. ! A `GC_MakeCircle2d` object provides a framework for: ! - defining the construction parameters; ! - running the construction algorithm; ! - querying the construction status and the resulting circle via `Value()`. ! @note A circle is parameterized in the range [0, 2*PI], and the X axis ! of its local coordinate system defines the parameter origin.
